description: For distinct atoms a and b, the valuation true exactly at b satisfies the implication from a to b and atom b, while it falsifies atom a.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.affirmingConsequent_countervaluation.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (a b : α)
  (hab : a ≠ b) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Countervaluation (fun c => if c = b then true else false)
    {(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom a).impl (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom b),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom b}
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom a)
